anomalies.observed: U17 pin 14 (SDA/VSS) and U44 pin 14 (SDA/VSS) are both connected to the GND net. Their pin 9 (I2C/~SPI) is also tied to GND, selecting I2C mode. In I2C mode, pin 14 is the SDA data line, not a ground pin.
anomalies.expected: In I2C mode (pin 9 low), U17 pin 14 and U44 pin 14 should be connected to the I2C SDA net (NET0187), which already connects to the other I2C devices (U13, U21, U46, U50, U55, Module2, J2).
anomalies.impact: The I2C SDA bus is shorted to ground through U17 and U44, preventing all I2C communication on the bus and potentially damaging the I2C master or other devices.

parsed.summary: The design files contain a serious anomaly: the SC16IS752 UARTs U17 and U44 are configured for I2C mode (pin 9 tied to GND) but their SDA pins (pin 14) are tied to GND instead of the I2C SDA net, shorting the I2C bus to ground.
